title: Site Reliability Specialist
jobDescription: About NCR VOYIX NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. Job Title: Site Reliability Specialist Location: Hyderabad, India Role Overview We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented GSRE L1 Engineer to join the Hawkeyes team. This role is responsible for supporting day-to-day site reliability operations, including cloud infrastructure maintenance, certificate management, deployment activities, and product support. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in ensuring system stability, security, and operational excellence across both GCP and Azure environments. Key Responsibilities Cloud Operations & Maintenance Perform patching and regular maintenance of servers hosted in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure. Monitor system health and proactively address infrastructure issues. Certificate (CERT) Management Manage and update SSL/TLS certificates across environments. Ensure compliance with security standards and prevent certificate expirations. Deployment & Release Support Execute code deployments across environments following established release processes. Validate deployments and troubleshoot issues as needed. Product & Application Support Provide L1 support for production systems and applications. Respond to incidents, perform initial triage, and escalate when necessary. Assist in root cause identification and resolution. Operational Excellence Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks. Contribute to documentation, knowledge base updates, and process improvements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, engineering, and support teams. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience). Basic to intermediate knowledge of cloud platforms (GCP and/or Azure). Understanding of: Server patching and maintenance Networking fundamentals SSL/TLS certificates and security concepts Familiarity with deployment processes and CI/CD pipelines. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment (shift-based if applicable). Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Linux/Windows server administration. Exposure to monitoring and alerting tools. Basic scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, or similar). Experience working in a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or production support environment. Key Competencies Strong attention to detail and operational discipline Excellent communication and collaboration skills Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively Customer-focused mindset with a proactive approach Why Join Hawkeyes Team?
